scene information.what: 雷欧吐槽自己来太空站做机械观测，结果误打误撞过上了研究生熬课题改数据的苦逼生活

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 你说离谱不离谱？我一个废土边缘长大的拾荒者，攒了半条命摸上来这太空站，就为了拆这里的战斗机器人，攒全结构蓝图。

actions.motion_detail: Hands in jacket pockets, shoulders relaxed, casual speaking gesture

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='你说离谱不离谱？我一个废土边缘' excl=0 ques=1 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=False

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 结果呢？上来三个月，机器人没拆两块，数据改了八十七版。那个AI导师天天发推送：雷欧啊，这个模型不对，那个数据偏差，再改改？

actions.motion_detail: Medium arm swing, counting on fingers to emphasize the number of revisions

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='结果呢？上来三个月，机器人没拆' excl=0 ques=2 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=True

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 上周我偷偷摸进下层实验区，刚拆开一个维修机器人的外壳，扳手还热着呢，AI导师的推送直接弹我视网膜上：课题中期报告，deadline今天午夜。

actions.motion_detail: Hand on chin, head tilted down, recalling the annoying experience

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='上周我偷偷摸进下层实验区，刚拆' excl=0 ques=0 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=False

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 我攥着扳手坐在零件堆里，凉风吹得后颈发麻，突然就反应过来了——

actions.motion_detail: Leans slightly forward, eyes wide with sudden realization

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='我攥着扳手坐在零件堆里，凉风吹' excl=0 ques=0 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=False

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 我这哪里是什么M-01号人类观察对象？我分明是读了个全宇宙最贵的深空在职研究生！

actions.motion_detail: Arms spread wide, loud voice, full of frustrated exaggeration

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='我这哪里是什么M-01号人类观' excl=1 ques=1 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=True

scene.speaker: 雷欧 (M-01)
scene.content: 合着不管你在废土捡垃圾还是来太空拆机器人，只要搞研究，就逃不过改课题熬大夜给导师打白工。得了，不说了，AI导师又催我改第八十九版数据了。

actions.motion_detail: Shrugs and spreads hands, helpless bitter smile

scene.shot_description: 雷欧 (M-01) stands centered in the foreground as the only visible subject.
scene.reason: text='合着不管你在废土捡垃圾还是来太' excl=0 ques=0 threat=False sarcasm=False pos=False
